detail: Competing offer from a Cambridge diagnostics company at GBP 49k. Counter approved on the basis that internal analysis already showed her below band midpoint for scope carried.
Took on Scotland cover during vacancy plus normal North region. Sustained 4 months. Adjustment reflects permanent scope increase not the temporary cover.
Approached by two employers during the 4.2.x remediation. Key knowledge holder on the timestamp defect. Adjustment made before he resigned rather than after.
Identified in interim pay analysis as below lower quartile with performance at Strong for 2 consecutive cycles. Correction applied without her having raised it.
Sole field cover for Scotland and Northern Ireland. Travel burden materially higher than peers. Flagged in the field service stress risk assessment.
Two RA resignations in 12 months citing pay. Market data showed Veridia below median for RA roles specifically. Precursor to the 2026 RA band premium.
Assumed DACH regional coordination in addition to field role following departure of the regional coordinator. Role not backfilled.
Salary approaching the L1 band minimum following benchmark refresh. Corrected to band lower quartile.
Verbal offer received from an instrument vendor. Assessed as genuine. Below-midpoint position confirmed independently.
Completed 12-week FSE programme and competency sign-off; now attending sites unaccompanied. Adjustment recognises the step change in autonomy ahead of the spring promotion window.
Approached directly by a customer (NHS trust) for a lead scientist post and by a competitor. Assessed as high flight risk with disproportionate knowledge concentration.
Executive search approach for a Head of Service role at a larger competitor. Retention critical - see key person analysis.
